description.value: Nam Vegan Express is a family-owned, counter-service vegan Vietnamese restaurant in Burnaby that has been operating since 2003, formerly known as Paradise Vegetarian Noodle House. The entirely plant-based menu spans traditional Vietnamese dishes including Pho, Bun Bo Hue, Wonton Soup, and Bao Buns, all made with fresh ingredients and imitation meats. A casual, welcoming spot run by mother-and-son duo Yen and Daryl, it caters equally to committed vegans and anyone seeking a healthy, hearty meal stop.
